extracted.intended_audience: Users of GAP (computational group theorists) implementing or using polycyclic group and crystallographic-group functionality
extracted.subtask_short: pcgs computation and operations in GAP
extracted.subtask_description: Reference rules and behavioral specifications for GAP functions and attributes dealing with Bravais groups, polycyclic generating sequences (pcgs), induced/canonical/modulo pcgs, and related operations. Covers preconditions, return behavior, and usage notes for these API routines.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsBravaisGroup(G)
rubrics_metrics.description: Test whether G coincides with its Bravais group.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Returns a boolean indicating if G equals its Bravais group. See BravaisGroup for the definition of the Bravais group.

rubrics_metrics.name: BravaisGroup(G)
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the Bravais group of a finite integer matrix group G.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Definition: Let C be the cone of positive definite quadratic forms Q invariant under g ↦ g Q g^tr for all g∈G; the Bravais group is the maximal subgroup of GL_n(Z) leaving the forms in that cone invariant. Equivalent alternative definition uses action g ↦ g^tr Q g (appropriate when groups act on rows vs columns). Both definitions yield same Bravais group. Applicable to finite integer matrix groups.

rubrics_metrics.name: BravaisSubgroups(G)
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the subgroups of the Bravais group of G which are themselves Bravais groups.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: No additional checks described; returns collection of subgroups meeting the Bravais-group property.

rubrics_metrics.name: BravaisSupergroups(G)
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the subgroups of GL_n(Z) that contain the Bravais group of G and are Bravais groups themselves.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to find larger Bravais groups in GL_n(Z) containing BravaisGroup(G).

rubrics_metrics.name: NormalizerInGLnZBravaisGroup(G)
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the normalizer of the Bravais group of G in the appropriate GL_n(Z).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides the normalizer subgroup; intended for crystallographic group computations where normalizers matter.

rubrics_metrics.name: Action-specific function naming (SomeThingOnRight / SomeThingOnLeft / SomeThing)
rubrics_metrics.description: For functions whose results depend on action convention (right-action on row vectors vs left-action on column vectors), GAP provides SomeThingOnRight and SomeThingOnLeft, and a generic SomeThing which dispatches based on CrystGroupDefaultAction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Crystallographic computations must use the correct action convention. The global variable CrystGroupDefaultAction (RightAction or LeftAction) determines which variant the generic name returns. Documentation explicitly mentions when functions have both variants.

rubrics_metrics.name: CrystGroupDefaultAction
rubrics_metrics.description: Global variable can be RightAction or LeftAction determining default action variant for crystallographic functions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Initial value is RightAction. Change with SetCrystGroupDefaultAction(action). Only RightAction and LeftAction are allowed.

rubrics_metrics.name: SetCrystGroupDefaultAction(action)
rubrics_metrics.description: Set the global CrystGroupDefaultAction to RightAction or LeftAction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use only the arguments RightAction and LeftAction. Affects which OnRight/OnLeft variant is returned by generic functions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition: polycyclic group and pc series
rubrics_metrics.description: G is polycyclic if there exists a subnormal series G = C1 > C2 > ... > C_{n+1}={1} with cyclic factors; such a series is called a pc series.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Every finite solvable group is polycyclic; some infinite solvable groups are not. Many GAP methods exploit polycyclic structure; methods are effective when group is given in pc-presentation. GAP library contains methods for finite polycyclic groups; the Polycyclic package handles infinite pc-presented groups.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pcgs (polycyclic generating sequence) definition and normal form
rubrics_metrics.description: A pcgs P = (g1,...,gn) satisfies C_i = ⟨C_{i+1}, g_i⟩ for i; every element has unique normal-word representation g = g1^{e1}...gn^{en} with exponents limited by relative orders r_i (or in Z if infinite).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Relative orders r_i are orders of g_i C_{i+1}. Depth and leading exponent defined for exponent vectors. For many algorithms require r_i either prime or infinity (i.e., prime-order pcgs).

rubrics_metrics.name: Pcgs(G)
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns a pcgs for group G; returns fail if G is not polycyclic.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If result is fail, the attribute value is not stored and filter HasPcgs is not set. Pcgs behaves like a list.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsPcgs(obj)
rubrics_metrics.description: Category test: whether obj is a pcgs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to check pcgs objects; examples show usage.

rubrics_metrics.name: CanEasilyComputePcgs(grp)
rubrics_metrics.description: Filter indicating whether a pcgs can be computed for grp cheaply.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: grp must be polycyclic. Not every polycyclic group has a cheap method. This filter is used for method selection and may change from false to true after computation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Guideline: Defining a Pcgs yourself
rubrics_metrics.description: User-supplied pcgs is allowed but elementary operations may be inefficient because generic methods are used.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: It may help to also supply relative orders via SetRelativeOrder. See IsPrimeOrdersPcgs if prime-order pcgs is required.

rubrics_metrics.name: PcgsByPcSequence(fam, pcs) / PcgsByPcSequenceNC
rubrics_metrics.description: Constructs a pcgs from a list pcs of elements in family fam. The NC variant always creates a new pcgs not induced by any other pcgs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Elements must lie in family fam. The constructed pcgs behaves like other pcgs objects; examples demonstrate RelativeOrders and ExponentsOfPcElement usage.

rubrics_metrics.name: RelativeOrders(pcgs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the list of relative orders of the pcgs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Relative orders indicate the allowed exponent ranges for normal forms; used widely in other operations.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsFiniteOrdersPcgs(pcgs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Tests whether all relative orders of pcgs are finite.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Simple property check used before operations that require finite orders.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsPrimeOrdersPcgs(pcgs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Tests whether the relative orders of pcgs are prime numbers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Many algorithms require a pcgs with prime relative orders. If absent, IsomorphismRefinedPcGroup may help to obtain such a pcgs.

rubrics_metrics.name: PcSeries(pcgs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the subnormal pc series determined by pcgs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful to extract the chain of subgroups defined by the pcgs.

rubrics_metrics.name: GroupOfPcgs(pcgs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the group generated by the elements in pcgs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Simple accessor for the parent group of a pcgs object.

rubrics_metrics.name: OneOfPcgs(pcgs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the identity of the group generated by pcgs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful when using pcgs as a generator list in operations that require an identity argument.

rubrics_metrics.name: RelativeOrderOfPcElement(pcgs, elm)
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the relative order of element elm with respect to a prime-order pcgs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assumes pcgs has prime relative orders; returns the order of elm in the relevant factor.

rubrics_metrics.name: ExponentOfPcElement(pcgs, elm, pos)
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the pos-th exponent of elm with respect to pcgs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use when extracting a single exponent position from an element's exponent vector.

rubrics_metrics.name: ExponentsOfPcElement(pcgs, elm[, posran])
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the exponent vector of elm with respect to pcgs; with posran returns subset of exponents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standard operation for converting group elements to exponent vectors; performance depends on pcgs representation.

rubrics_metrics.name: DepthOfPcElement(pcgs, elm)
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the depth (first nonzero exponent index) of elm with respect to pcgs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Depth and leading exponent used in many reductions and canonicalization operations.

rubrics_metrics.name: LeadingExponentOfPcElement(pcgs, elm)
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the leading exponent ek of elm with respect to pcgs where k is the depth.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used in operations that normalize or compare induced pcgs elements.

rubrics_metrics.name: PcElementByExponents(pcgs, list) / PcElementByExponentsNC
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the group element corresponding to exponent vector list with respect to pcgs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Exponents in list must be within permissible ranges. Not guaranteed to reduce exponents modulo relative orders; use LinearCombinationPcgs to permit negative exponents or to get reductions. NC variant skips length and range checks; third-argument version can give exponents only w.r.t. selected basis indices.

rubrics_metrics.name: LinearCombinationPcgs(pcgs, list[, one])
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the product ∏_i pcgs[i]^{list[i]}; permits negative exponents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If pcgs is a raw list of group elements (not a pcgs object) an identity element one must be supplied. list can be empty. Preferred when negative exponents or modular reduction needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: SiftedPcElement(pcgs, elm)
rubrics_metrics.description: Sifts elm through pcgs, reducing it if depth matches depth of one of the generators of pcgs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: pcgs must be an induced pcgs and elm must lie in the span of the parent of pcgs. Returns identity if elm lies in subgroup generated by pcgs.

rubrics_metrics.name: CanonicalPcElement(ipcgs, elm)
rubrics_metrics.description: Reduces elm at the induced pcgs so that exponents of the reduced result are zero at depths with generators in ipcgs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Elements whose quotient lies in group generated by ipcgs yield the same canonical element. Useful for canonical representatives modulo a subgroup.

rubrics_metrics.name: ReducedPcElement(pcgs, x, y)
rubrics_metrics.description: Reduces x by dividing off from the left a power of y so that the leading coefficient w.r.t. pcgs becomes zero.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: x and y must have the same depth. Used to eliminate leading exponents via left division by powers.

rubrics_metrics.name: CleanedTailPcElement(pcgs, elm, dep)
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns an element in span of pcgs whose exponents for indices 1..dep-1 match those of elm; remaining exponents undefined.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to obtain simpler representatives when only tail representatives are required. Unlike HeadPcElementByNumber it is only guaranteed to zero out trailing coefficients when it can be done cheaply.

rubrics_metrics.name: HeadPcElementByNumber(pcgs, elm, dep)
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns an element in the span of pcgs whose exponents for indices 1..dep-1 match those of elm and remaining exponents are zero.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to get representatives truncated to a head of the pcgs; contrasts with CleanedTailPcElement which may not zero trailing coefficients if expensive.

rubrics_metrics.name: ExponentsConjugateLayer(mpcgs, elm, e)
rubrics_metrics.description: Computes exponents of elm^e with respect to mpcgs under certain layer conditions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requirements: elm in span of mpcgs; e a pc element in span of parent pcgs of mpcgs; mpcgs must be the modulo pcgs for an abelian layer (typical when acting on a chief factor). If mpcgs is induced by the family pcgs, exponents may be computed by lookup rather than group computation.

rubrics_metrics.name: ExponentsOfRelativePower(pcgs, i)
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the exponent vector of p^e (where p=pcgs[i] and e is its relative order) with respect to pcgs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For family pcgs or those induced by it this can be faster than computing the element and then its exponent vector.

rubrics_metrics.name: ExponentsOfConjugate(pcgs, i, j)
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns exponents of pcgs[i]^{pcgs[j]} with respect to pcgs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May be optimized for family pcgs or induced pcgs to avoid explicit multiplication and re-collection.

rubrics_metrics.name: ExponentsOfCommutator(pcgs, i, j)
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the exponent vector of the commutator Comm(pcgs[i], pcgs[j]) with respect to pcgs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Similarly may be faster for family or induced pcgs than explicit computation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Induced pcgs: definition and construction
rubrics_metrics.description: Given U ≤ G and a parent pcgs P of G, an induced pcgs Q for U is formed by selecting elements in U ∩ C_{ij} that generate the factors; equivalently the matrix of exponent vectors of chosen elements w.r.t. P is upper triangular.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Induced pcgs Q is not unique. Elements in an induced pcgs may not have leading coefficient 1 relative to parent; leading coefficients stored in LeadCoeffsIGS when needed. Induced pcgs supports all elementary pcgs operations but arbitrary pcgs are not in general induced pcgs for technical reasons.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsInducedPcgs(pcgs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Category: whether pcgs is an induced pcgs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An induced pcgs is a subcategory of pcgs objects.

rubrics_metrics.name: InducedPcgsByPcSequence(pcgs, pcs) / InducedPcgsByPcSequenceNC(pcgs, pcs[, depths])
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns an induced pcgs with the listed elements pcs if they form an induced pcgs with respect to pcgs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In NC variant depths can be provided; otherwise computed. NC variant used where checks are relaxed.

rubrics_metrics.name: ParentPcgs(pcgs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the pcgs by which pcgs was induced; if not induced returns pcgs itself.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use to inspect parent/child pcgs relationships; examples show ParentPcgs on induced pcgs returns the original pcgs.

rubrics_metrics.name: InducedPcgs(pcgs, grp)
rubrics_metrics.description: Computes a pcgs for subgroup grp that is induced by pcgs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: InducedPcgs is a wrapper; actual computation methods should be installed for InducedPcgsOp. If pcgs has a parent, result is induced w.r.t. parent.

rubrics_metrics.name: InducedPcgsByGenerators(pcgs, gens) / InducedPcgsByGeneratorsNC
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns an induced pcgs for subgroup generated by gens with respect to pcgs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: NC variant available; used to produce induced pcgs from generator lists.

rubrics_metrics.name: InducedPcgsByPcSequenceAndGenerators(pcgs, ind, gens)
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns an induced pcgs of subgroup generated by ind and gens; ind must be an induced pcgs wrt pcgs (or list of elements forming such an igs) and will be used as initial sequence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Allows incremental construction starting from an initial induced sequence.

rubrics_metrics.name: LeadCoeffsIGS(igs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Attribute storing leading coefficients of igs relative to the parent pcgs; the i-th entry (if bound) is the leading exponent of element of igs that has depth i in parent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used when renormalization is needed in algorithms. Note it cannot be assigned to components of objects created by InducedPcgsByPcSequenceNC because permutation group methods call it during postprocessing where coefficients may not yet be computed.

rubrics_metrics.name: ExtendedPcgs(N, gens)
rubrics_metrics.description: Extends an induced pcgs N to a new induced pcgs by prepending gens.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: No checks performed that the result actually yields an induced pcgs; caller responsibility to ensure validity.

rubrics_metrics.name: SubgroupByPcgs(G, pcgs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the subgroup of G generated by the elements of pcgs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Convenience function to create subgroup objects from pcgs generators; induced pcgs get stored automatically if used appropriately.

rubrics_metrics.name: Canonical induced pcgs (definition)
rubrics_metrics.description: An induced pcgs Q of U is canonical if the matrix of exponent vectors (w.r.t. parent P) contains normed vectors only and above each leading entry there are only zeros (i.e., Hermite normal form).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Canonical pcgs is unique for U with respect to P and can be used to compare subgroups for equality.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsCanonicalPcgs(pcgs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Property test whether an induced pcgs is canonical (matrix in Hermite normal form).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Canonical property ensures uniqueness and is computed by checking Hermite normal form of exponent matrix.

rubrics_metrics.name: CanonicalPcgs(pcgs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the canonical pcgs corresponding to induced pcgs pcgs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Converts an induced pcgs to its unique canonical representative; useful for subgroup comparisons.

rubrics_metrics.name: ModuloPcgs(G, N)
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns a modulo pcgs for the factor G/N which must be solvable (N may be non-solvable).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Returns a pcgs for the factor but not guaranteed to be compatible with other pcgs. If a compatible modulo pcgs is required, use the mod operator on compatible induced pcgs (P mod I). Modulo pcgs often used to compute in factor groups without explicitly constructing them.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsModuloPcgs(obj)
rubrics_metrics.description: Category test whether obj is a modulo pcgs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Every pcgs is also a modulo pcgs for the trivial subgroup.

rubrics_metrics.name: NumeratorOfModuloPcgs(pcgs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns a generating set for the numerator of the modulo pcgs pcgs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides the original generating elements lifting the modulo pcgs.

rubrics_metrics.name: DenominatorOfModuloPcgs(pcgs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns a generating set for the denominator (the subgroup factored out) of the modulo pcgs pcgs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful to recover the kernel subgroup when working with modulo pcgs.

rubrics_metrics.name: \mod(P, I) (mod operator for two pcgs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Computes a modulo pcgs of G mod N from compatible pcgs P of G and induced pcgs I of a normal subgroup N (both induced with respect to same parent).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Result is subset of P and is compatible with P (or its parent). Advantage: NumeratorOfModuloPcgs and DenominatorOfModuloPcgs return P and I, respectively, making them unique. Use when compatibility between pcgs and modulo pcgs is required.

rubrics_metrics.name: CorrespondingGeneratorsByModuloPcgs(mpcgs, imgs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Given a modulo pcgs mpcgs for factor of G and a subgroup U generated by imgs that covers the factor, computes elements in U corresponding to the generators of the modulo pcgs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Computation of induced generating sets may not be possible for some modulo pcgs; caller must ensure U covers the factor for the modulo pcgs.

rubrics_metrics.name: CanonicalPcgsByGeneratorsWithImages(pcgs, gens, imgs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Computes a canonical induced pcgs for the span of gens and simultaneously performs same transformations on imgs to preserve correspondence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to represent homomorphisms from a pc group by maintaining parallel generator/image lists.

rubrics_metrics.name: ProjectedPcElement(pcgs, fpcgs, elm)
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the image in H = G/N of an element elm of G using pcgs and fpcgs correspondence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to map elements into factor group's representation without constructing homomorphism explicitly. No validity tests performed—inputs must be compatible heads/tails as described.

rubrics_metrics.name: ProjectedInducedPcgs(pcgs, fpcgs, ipcgs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Given ipcgs induced w.r.t. pcgs, returns an induced pcgs with respect to fpcgs consisting of nontrivial images of ipcgs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ipcgs must be induced with respect to pcgs. Useful to get induced pcgs in factor representation.

rubrics_metrics.name: LiftedPcElement(pcgs, fpcgs, elm)
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns a preimage in G of an element elm of H (factor) using pcgs/fpcgs correspondence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to lift elements from factor representation back to numerator without constructing explicit homomorphism.

rubrics_metrics.name: LiftedInducedPcgs(pcgs, fpcgs, ipcgs, ker)
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns an induced pcgs with respect to pcgs consisting of preimages of ipcgs appended by elements in ker (assuming bijection of pcgs mod ker to fpcgs).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ker might be a simple element list. ipcgs must be induced w.r.t. fpcgs. No input validity checks performed.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsPcgsElementaryAbelianSeries(pcgs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns true if pcgs refines an elementary abelian normal series.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If true, IndicesEANormalSteps gives indices in pcgs at which normal subgroups of the series start. Typically set by PcgsElementaryAbelianSeries.

rubrics_metrics.name: PcgsElementaryAbelianSeries(G) / PcgsElementaryAbelianSeries(list)
rubrics_metrics.description: Computes a pcgs that refines an elementary abelian series for G; second variant runs through normal subgroups provided in list.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: IndicesEANormalSteps attribute can be used to extract the steps; useful when algorithms require elementary abelian layers.

rubrics_metrics.name: IndicesEANormalSteps(pcgs) / IndicesEANormalStepsBounded(pcgs, bound)
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns sorted list of integer indices indicating tails of pcgs that generate normal subgroups in an elementary-abelian series. Bounded variant aims to ensure no factor is larger than bound.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List starts with 1 and ends with n+1. Not guaranteed to work for arbitrary pcgs not obtained from special series. Typically set by PcgsElementaryAbelianSeries.

rubrics_metrics.name: EANormalSeriesByPcgs(pcgs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the actual series of normal subgroups corresponding to IndicesEANormalSteps for pcgs obtained from an elementary-abelian series.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides explicit subgroup chain for series-based computations.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsPcgsCentralSeries(pcgs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns true if pcgs refines a central series.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If true, IndicesCentralNormalSteps gives indices where central normal subgroups start.

rubrics_metrics.name: PcgsCentralSeries(G)
rubrics_metrics.description: Computes a pcgs for G that refines a central series; IndicesCentralNormalSteps gives indices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful when algorithms require central-layer refinement, e.g., for p-groups.

rubrics_metrics.name: IndicesCentralNormalSteps(pcgs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns sorted list of indices indicating tails of pcgs that generate normal subgroups in a central elementary-abelian series.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List starts with 1 and ends with n+1. Not guaranteed to exist for arbitrary pcgs; typically set by PcgsCentralSeries.

rubrics_metrics.name: CentralNormalSeriesByPcgs(pcgs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns actual series of normal subgroups corresponding to IndicesCentralNormalSteps.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides explicit central series when available.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsPcgsPCentralSeriesPGroup(pcgs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns true if pcgs refines a p-central elementary-abelian series for a p-group.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If true, IndicesPCentralNormalStepsPGroup gives indices of the series steps.

rubrics_metrics.name: PcgsPCentralSeriesPGroup(G)
rubrics_metrics.description: Computes a pcgs for the p-group G that refines a p-central elementary-abelian series.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: IndicesPCentralNormalStepsPGroup gives step indices for this series.

rubrics_metrics.name: IndicesPCentralNormalStepsPGroup(pcgs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns sorted indices indicating tails of pcgs generating normal subgroups in a p-central elementary-abelian series (for p-groups).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List starts with 1 and ends with n+1. Typical usage: set by PcgsPCentralSeriesPGroup.

rubrics_metrics.name: PCentralNormalSeriesByPcgsPGroup(pcgs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the actual p-central elementary-abelian normal series corresponding to IndicesPCentralNormalStepsPGroup.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides explicit subgroup chain for p-central computations.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsPcgsChiefSeries(pcgs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns true if pcgs refines a chief series.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If true, IndicesChiefNormalSteps gives indices where chief-series normal subgroups start.

rubrics_metrics.name: PcgsChiefSeries(G)
rubrics_metrics.description: Computes a pcgs for G that refines a chief series.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: IndicesChiefNormalSteps gives the indices for the normal subgroups in this series.

rubrics_metrics.name: IndicesChiefNormalSteps(pcgs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns sorted indices indicating tails of pcgs which generate normal subgroups in a chief series.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List starts with 1 and ends with n+1. Not guaranteed for arbitrary pcgs; typically set by PcgsChiefSeries.

rubrics_metrics.name: ChiefNormalSeriesByPcgs(pcgs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the actual series of normal subgroups corresponding to IndicesChiefNormalSteps for a pcgs obtained from a chief series.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides explicit chief series subgroup chain when available.

rubrics_metrics.name: IndicesNormalSteps(pcgs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns indices of all steps in the pc series which are normal in the group defined by the pcgs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A more general (and typically slower) function than the specialized index functions for specific series types.

rubrics_metrics.name: NormalSeriesByPcgs(pcgs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the subgroups in the pc series which are normal in the group defined by the pcgs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: General purpose accessor to the normal steps of the pc series; may be slower than specialized functions.

rubrics_metrics.name: SumFactorizationFunctionPcgs(parentpcgs, n, u, kerpcgs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Computes the sum and intersection of lists n and u whose elements form modulo pcgs induced by parentpcgs for two subgroups modulo kernel kerpcgs. Returns record with sum, intersection, and factorization function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: kerpcgs can be given as explicit pcgs or starting depth if it is a tail of parentpcgs (more efficient). The factor group modulo kerpcgs generated by n must be elementary abelian and normal under u. Returned sum and intersection are lists of pc elements (not pcgs) to avoid unnecessary creation of induced pcgs. factorization function decomposes elements of the sum into components in u and n.

rubrics_metrics.name: Special pcgs (definition and use)
rubrics_metrics.description: A special pcgs is a pcgs with particularly nice properties (e.g., always refines an elementary abelian series; for p-groups refines a central series).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Special pcgs are closely related to a Hall system and maximal subgroups; they permit particularly efficient algorithms. Algorithms to compute them are available (Leedham-Green, improvements by Bettina Eick); see reference [Eic97] for details.
